# Velocis AI

> AI development studio that ships production-ready AI products 10x faster than traditional development teams.

## About
Velocis AI is an AI development studio focused on speed and quality. We deliver production-ready AI solutions in days and weeks, not months. Our agent-powered development teams combine AI automation with human expertise to compress discovery into delivery. We offer a unique guarantee: MVP in 2 weeks or it's free.

## Services
- AI Agent Development: Custom autonomous agents for conversational AI, multi-agent systems, and complex workflows — production-ready from day one
- Rapid Prototyping: Working AI prototypes in 48 hours, enabling fast validation and iteration
- Production Scaling: Infrastructure that handles millions of requests, from proof-of-concept to planet-scale
- Continuous Optimization: AI systems that learn and improve daily through monitoring, fine-tuning, and iterative refinement

## Key Differentiators
- 48-hour first prototype delivery
- 2-week MVP guarantee (free if we miss the deadline)
- 10x faster than traditional AI development
- Zero technical debt methodology
- Agent-powered development teams

## Industries Served
Startups, SaaS companies, fintech, healthtech, e-commerce, logistics, enterprise software
